description: This entry covers What Cybernetics Studies as part of the fundamentals of cybernetics. overview: Cybernetics is the field concerned with The science of control and communication: feedback governing machines, organisms, and societies. What Cybernetics Studies belongs to its essential core. Concretely: Feedback — outputs looped back as inputs, stabilizing or amplifying systems. And Control theory — the mathematics of keeping systems on target. Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Foundations tier.
core_concepts: Feedback: outputs looped back as inputs, stabilizing or amplifying systems.
Control theory: the mathematics of keeping systems on target.
key_laws: Ashby's law: only variety can absorb variety, the regulator must match the disturbance.
vocabulary: Setpoint: the target value a controller maintains.
Servomechanism: the automatic position or velocity controller.

It is taught at the Advanced level of the teaching ladder, building from first principles toward professional practice, with each concept defined before it is used.
overview: Cybernetics is the field concerned with The science of control and communication: feedback governing machines, organisms, and societies. Current Research Frontiers in Cybernetics belongs to its essential core. Concretely: Positive feedback — the runaway loops driving growth or collapse. And Homeostasis — the body's cybernetic regulation of its internal state. Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Advanced tier.
core_concepts: Positive feedback: the runaway loops driving growth or collapse.
Homeostasis: the body's cybernetic regulation of its internal state.
key_laws: Ashby's law: only variety can absorb variety, the regulator must match the disturbance.
Good regulator theorem: every good regulator contains a model of its system.
vocabulary: Setpoint: the target value a controller maintains.
Servomechanism: the automatic position or velocity controller.
methods: Block-diagram modeling: mapping signals and feedback paths.
history: Cybernetics was named by Wiener in 1948, uniting wartime control engineering with biology; the Macy conferences spread it across disciplines. It fathered control theory, AI, and systems thinking, and second-order cybernetics reframed the observer.
